request: Analyze GSE122628 for PMID 31433691 (The impact of skeletal muscle contraction on CD146(+)Lin(-) pericytes.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (SMARTer Stranded Total RNA-seq Pico v2, HiSeq 4000 SE101) of FACS-sorted CD146+CD45-CD31- pericytes from gastrocnemius-soleus
final.sample_inclusion: 6 male C57BL/6J WT mice, 14 wk; 3 e-stim, 3 sham (GEO overall_design)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of a single 10-min bout of electrically stimulated (eccentric) muscle contraction vs sham on the transcriptome of CD146+Lin- pericytes, 3 h post-contraction
planned_contrasts: e-stim vs sham, CD146+Lin- pericytes, 3 h (abstract; GEO overall_design); paper DEG count not available from abstract
final.repeated_measure_unit: none (one sample per mouse, independent groups)
final.normalization: Salmon -> tximport lengthScaledTPM gene counts (GEO data_processing)
final.paper_method: edgeR quasi-likelihood (GEO data_processing: counts analyzed directly using the edgeR-quasi method)

paper_threshold.source_locator: not stated in abstract or GEO; full text unavailable

final.paper_results: Abstract: upregulation of genes related to immunomodulation and extracellular matrix remodeling in CD146+Lin- pericytes after contraction; no counts or gene names given

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Only the PubMed abstract (PMID 31433691) and the GEO series/sample records are available; no full text. The abstract states RNA-seq of CD146+Lin- pericytes 3 h after a single e-stim session vs sham; GEO overall_design confirms n=3/group male mice, and data_processing names the edgeR-quasi method. No threshold or DEG count is recoverable.

cell type CD146+CD45-CD31- pericytes matches abstract

ownership.reasoning: Series links PMID 31433691; supplementary gene-count file belongs to this series and its columns map one-to-one to the series samples.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns S1..U3 are the bracketed codes in GEO titles (Stim 1 [S1]); group from source_name_ch1 (S)/(U), consistent with treatment Exercised/Not Exercised.

matrix.reasoning: Only 25% of values are integers, max 1.9e6, median 8.7; GEO data_processing: Salmon quasi-mapping + tximport lengthScaledTPM summed to gene level -> estimated (length-scaled) counts on the count scale, not TPM. Paper input is the same file, analyzed with edgeR-quasi.

design.reasoning: Single factor, two independent arms (3 vs 3); e-stim induced contraction is the paper's exercise model. Treatment column (Exercised/Not Exercised) is identical to source_name grouping.

candidates.reason_rejected: identical partition to source_name_ch1; used one column

covariance.reasoning: Independent mice, all male, same age/strain, one sequencing lane (L002 for all in description); no batch or pairing recorded.

final.method: edgeR (quasi-likelihood F-test, TMM) on rounded tximport lengthScaledTPM counts

paper_route.reason: repository edgeR executor (inmoose) enforces integer input; counts are rounded to nearest integer, which edgeR in R would accept unrounded; effect is negligible except for very low counts

deviations: counts rounded to integers before edgeR
paper's low-expression filter unknown (abstract only); executor defaults used

method.reasoning: Reproduce the paper's stated edgeR-quasi route. Rounding of tximport lengthScaledTPM counts is the standard documented recipe for count-based tools on tximport output.

final.deviation_note: Paper threshold not recoverable from the abstract; workflow default BH-FDR < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff. Raw p < 0.05 recorded as an audit count only.

threshold.reasoning: No full text; abstract and GEO give no cutoff.

caveats: Comparison with the paper rests on the abstract only (no DEG count or gene list available)
counts rounded for the integer-only edgeR executor
threshold is the workflow default, not the paper's

Immunomodulation direction agrees with the abstract (GSEA Hallmark inflammatory response, IL6-JAK-STAT3, TNFa-NFkB, allograft rejection positive; S100a8/S100a9, Il1rn, Cxcl3, Ptx3 up), but Hallmark EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION (ECM-rich set, NES -2.18) and ANGIOGENESIS (NES -2.15) are NEGATIVELY enriched, which does not support the abstract's ECM-remodelling up-regulation at the Hallmark level; the paper's specific ECM genes are unknown (abstract only)

study.reasoning: Paper's stated method on the paper's deposited input; the abstract reports only a direction (up-regulation of immunomodulatory and ECM-remodelling genes).
